details: The ongoing conflict between Iran and the United States continues to significantly impact global affairs, particularly affecting oil prices and trade through the vital Strait of Hormuz. Iran is reportedly maintaining its blockade of the strait, rejecting US pressure, and has reportedly fired missiles and drones at Jordan and Egypt, further increasing market jitters and causing spikes in oil prices. US President Donald Trump has urged Americans to accept higher petrol prices amidst the escalating tensions. No peace talks are currently planned, and economic sanctions and regional attacks are contributing to heightened uncertainty.
title: Iran-US Conflict Escalates, Driving Oil Price Volatility

details: Fitch Ratings has affirmed the United States' sovereign credit rating at 'AA+' with a stable outlook, citing the country's large economy, high per-capita income, and the US dollar's status as the world's leading reserve currency. However, Fitch highlighted persistent fiscal deficits, elevated inflation (projected to average 3.4% in 2026, above the Federal Reserve's 2% target), rising interest costs, and weakening labor demand as key risks. The agency forecasts the general government deficit to widen to 7.4% of GDP in 2026.
title: Fitch Affirms US Credit Rating at 'AA+' Amid Fiscal Concerns
